bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to landlord and tenant; permitting local moratoriums on evictions based on nonpayment of rent; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 504B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[504B.372] LOCAL EVICTION MORATORIUM PERMITTED.

Notwithstanding sections 504B.281 to 504B.371, in the event of a public safety threat or natural disaster, or for humanitarian purposes, a municipality, as defined in section 469.1812, subdivision 3, may, by ordinance or rule, prohibit the filing of an eviction action based on nonpayment of rent for a period up to 90 days.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: Notwithstanding sections 504B.281 to 504B.371, in the event of a public safety threat or natural disaster, or for humanitarian purposes, a municipality, as defined in section 469.1812, subdivision 3, may, by ordinance or rule, prohibit the filing of an eviction action based on nonpayment of rent for a period up to 90 days.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
